key.name: font-scaling-percentage
key.description: Allows users to select a scaling factor for the application font size.

key.name: theme-preference
key.description: Allows users to choose between System, Light, or Dark themes.

key.name: custom-dns-server
key.description: Specifies the custom DNS server IP address to be used for DNS lookups. Leave empty to use the system default.

key.name: window-width
key.description: The width of the application window.

key.name: window-height
key.description: The height of the application window.

key.name: window-is-maximized
key.description: Whether the application window is maximized.

key.name: http-output-header-key-color
key.description: Defines the color used for displaying the keys of HTTP headers (e.g., 'Content-Type').

key.name: http-output-header-value-color
key.description: Defines the color used for displaying the values of HTTP headers.

key.name: http-output-special-row-color
key.summary: Color for special rows in HTTP output
key.description: Defines the color used for special informational rows in the HTTP output, like URL or Status lines.

key.name: custom-user-agents
key.default: [('Firefox (Latest) on Linux', 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:125.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/125.0'), ('Firefox ESR on Linux', 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:115.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/115.0'), ('Chrome (Latest) on Linux', 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/114.0.0.0 Safari/537.36')]
key.summary: A list of custom User-Agent string pairs (title, value).
key.description: Users can add their own User-Agent strings to this list. Each entry consists of a display title and the full User-Agent value.

key.name: default-user-agent-title
key.description: Stores the title of the User-Agent string that is selected by default in the HTTP tool.

key.name: output-font
key.description: Sets the font family and size for text in HTTP, DNS, Nmap, and WebScan result views. Format is "FamilyName [Style] Size", e.g., "Ubuntu Mono 11".
